queue.title: Job order
queue.intro: Waiting work goes in this order. A running job is never stopped.
queue.interactiveBusy: {{task}} in progress: background work waits until it is done.
queue.hold: {{holder}} is using {{model}} on the graphics card. Jobs that would unload it wait; Run now lets one go ahead.

list.resumeTriggered: Resume pending indexing triggered (will re-queue matching docs)
list.label: Label

nightShift.title: Night shift
nightShift.rule: starts after {{minutes}} min with no one at the machine, one job at a time
nightShift.pauseHelp: While paused the night shift starts nothing. Jobs set for a time still run.
nightShift.noDesktopIdle: Desktop idle time is not available here, so only activity in Guaardvark counts as someone being at the machine.
nightShift.loadFailed: The schedule could not be read: {{error}}
nightShift.empty: Nothing is scheduled. Use Schedule a job here, Add to night shift on a feature's page, or /schedule in chat.
nightShift.dragHelp: Drag to change the order. The night shift runs jobs top to bottom.
nightShift.dragLabel: Move {{name}}. Arrow up and down change its place.
nightShift.removeKeeps: Files already made by other jobs stay where they are.
nightShift.addHelp: Runs overnight when the machine has been left alone, after the jobs already scheduled.
nightShift.atIntro: The job starts at this time on this machine, within a minute.
nightShift.atPast: Pick a time that is still ahead.
nightShift.added: Added to the night shift. It is on the Jobs page under Scheduled.
nightShift.addedAt: Scheduled for {{time}}. It is on the Jobs page under Scheduled.
nightShift.addFailed: The job could not be scheduled: {{error}}
nightShift.notForFiles: Scheduling takes typed prompts. A CSV or blueprint upload starts now.
nightShift.footerHelp: Jobs waiting for the night shift or for a set time. Opens the Jobs page.
nightShift.scheduleJobHelp: Pick a feature, describe it and say when it should run.
nightShift.pauseJob: Pause: keep it in the list without a time. Change when or Run now starts it again.

schedule.title: Schedule a job
schedule.intro: Pick what to make and describe it. It is saved here and made later: on the night shift, or at the time you set.
schedule.countHelp: Each one is saved as its own job.
schedule.defaults: Runs with that feature's current defaults. For the model, size and other settings, schedule it from its page:
schedule.loadFailed: The list of features could not be read: {{error}}

videoJob.name: Job name
videoJob.started: This job has started, so its settings can no longer change.

styles.none: None: send the prompt as written

videoJob.runAgainHelp: Saves a new job with these settings. This one stays in the list as it ran.
videoJob.tooLong: This model's longest clip is {{max}} s.
videoJob.tooShort: This model's shortest clip is {{min}} s.
